newsitem.title: USA: Falcon Products to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: Falcon Products to buy back shares.

text.p: Falcon Products Inc said on Tuesday that its directors had authorized the repurchase of up to 500,000 shares of its common stock in open market transactions.

The authorization brings the number of shares for repurchase to 1.075 million, from 575,000, the company said in a statement, adding that it bought back roughly 387,000 shares under its previously authorized stock repurchase program.
In addition, Falcon Products attributed a second quarter growth in sales to increases in the lodging and contract/office furniture markets.

The company released its second quarter earnings results on Tuesday, posting record net sales of $29.3 million, a 13 percent increase from $25.8 million during the year-ago period. Net earnings were $1.9 million, or $0.20 per share, compared with net earnings of $2.1 million, or $0.22 per share for the year-ago period.
Falcon Products designs and manufactures products for the hospitality and lodging, food service and office furniture industries.
